prompt: I have a tendency to keep browser tabs open. I currently have over 200 of them open at this time. What could I do to avoid keeping so many tabs open at all time?
response: Keeping many tabs open can be useful, but if it feels unmanageable, consider grouping similar tabs together using browser extensions that create tab folders. Alternatively, regularly closing tabs you no longer need or using a tab management tool can help keep your browsing more organized. This approach helps maintain a clean browsing environment and improves focus.
